summary.name: Focus
summary.one_liner: Focus is a Pomodoro-based deep work timer app with built-in task and project management, time tracking, and activity stats across Apple devices.
use_cases: structure a workday into focused sessions and breaks
track focused hours without a separate log
organize tasks into projects and work through them
set and track a daily focus goal
summary.what_it_does: The app combines a customizable focus timer, based on the Pomodoro Technique, with task and project lists. Users pick a task, start a timed session with flexible session and break lengths, and the app records time automatically. A daily and weekly Activity view, daily goals, and charts, timeline and calendar views show focused time over time. Tasks, timer, and stats sync through the user's own iCloud. Widgets, Live Activities, Control Center controls, and Siri & Shortcuts are supported, plus an optional black-and-white look.
notable: Full-screen alarm when a session ends on iOS 26
Data stored in the user's own iCloud, no ads, data never sold
Accessibility support including VoiceOver, Voice Control, Dynamic Type and Reduce Motion
caveats: Full-screen alarm is specific to iOS 26; other platforms get a notification
Pricing is not stated on the page; the App Store listing is linked from the awesome-mac entry only
